'''2018 US Nationals Jan Berueda DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Berueda]] at [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jan Berueda]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Vile Berueda DS 2018 Nats.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141216/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ Internet Archive]
